title: Sources
description: Where the power comes from: the two solar arrays and PG&E.

panels.title: Main House Solar now
panels.description: Latest SolarEdge quarter-hour mean, if one arrived in the last 45 minutes. The vendor cloud runs about a quarter-hour behind. Blank means unknown, never zero.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT s.value AS v
FROM core_sample s
JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
WHERE so.slug = 'solaredge' AND se.metric IN ('production_w', 'demand_w')
  AND s.ts >= datetime('now', '-45 minutes')
ORDER BY s.ts DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Solar produced
panels.description: Both arrays over the selected range, integrated from stored samples only.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', s.ts) AS INTEGER) / 900) * 900 AS t,
         so.slug AS slug,
         SUM(s.value * s.duration_s) / SUM(s.duration_s) AS w
  FROM core_sample s
  JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
  JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
  WHERE se.metric IN ('production_w', 'demand_w')
    AND s.ts >= datetime(($__from / 1000 / 900) * 900, 'unixepoch')
    AND s.ts <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), p AS (
  SELECT t,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'solaredge' THEN w END) AS main,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'envoy' THEN w END) AS guest,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'eagle' THEN w END) AS grid
  FROM raw
  GROUP BY t
), b AS (
  SELECT t, main, guest, grid,
         COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) AS solar,
         CASE WHEN grid IS NOT NULL
               AND (main IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(guest, 0) < 20)
               AND COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) + grid >= 0
              THEN COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) + grid END AS load
  FROM p
)
SELECT SUM(solar) * 900 / 3600.0 / 1000.0 AS v FROM b

panels.title: Supply — where the power is coming from
panels.description: Solar from each array plus grid import, stacked: the top edge is everything being supplied. Quarter-hour means (wider when zoomed out). A break is a real gap in the data.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', s.ts) AS INTEGER) / MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)) * MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900) AS t,
         so.slug AS slug,
         SUM(s.value * s.duration_s) / SUM(s.duration_s) AS w
  FROM core_sample s
  JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
  JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
  WHERE se.metric IN ('production_w', 'demand_w')
    AND s.ts >= datetime(($__from / 1000 / MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)) * MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900), 'unixepoch')
    AND s.ts <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), p AS (
  SELECT t,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'solaredge' THEN w END) AS main,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'envoy' THEN w END) AS guest,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'eagle' THEN w END) AS grid
  FROM raw
  GROUP BY t
), b AS (
  SELECT t, main, guest, grid,
         COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) AS solar,
         CASE WHEN grid IS NOT NULL
               AND (main IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(guest, 0) < 20)
               AND COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) + grid >= 0
              THEN COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) + grid END AS load
  FROM p
), ticks(t) AS (
  SELECT ($__from / 1000 / MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)) * MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t + MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900) FROM ticks WHERE t + MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900) < $__to / 1000
)
SELECT ticks.t AS time,
       b.main AS "Main House Solar",
       b.guest AS "Guest House Solar",
       MAX(b.grid, 0) AS "PG&E Grid import"
FROM ticks
LEFT JOIN b ON b.t = ticks.t
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Solar production per month — all history
panels.description: Every month on record for both arrays (main array from 2016, guest house from 2023). Only stored samples count, so a month with missing data reads low.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', strftime('%Y-%m-01', s.ts, 'localtime'), 'utc') AS INTEGER) AS time,
       SUM(CASE WHEN so.slug = 'solaredge' THEN s.value * s.duration_s END) / 3600000.0 AS "Main House Solar",
       SUM(CASE WHEN so.slug = 'envoy' THEN s.value * s.duration_s END) / 3600000.0 AS "Guest House Solar"
FROM core_sample s
JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
WHERE se.metric = 'production_w'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Yearly yield per installed kW
panels.description: kWh produced per kW of panels, per calendar year. A slow decline is normal ageing (roughly half a percent a year); a step down is a fault. The first and current years are partial.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT strftime('%Y', s.ts, 'localtime') AS year,
       SUM(CASE WHEN so.slug = 'solaredge' THEN s.value * s.duration_s END) / 3600000.0 / 8.625 AS "Main House Solar",
       SUM(CASE WHEN so.slug = 'envoy' THEN s.value * s.duration_s END) / 3600000.0 / 1.75 AS "Guest House Solar"
FROM core_sample s
JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
WHERE se.metric = 'production_w'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
